description: Fires when column 0 (the leftmost column) is completely full, most strongly on the move right after the opponent drops the stone that fills it. The signal fades over the following moves, slowly if column 0 filled early in the game and fast if it filled late. It is weak when column 0 fills on a nearly full board (about 35+ stones). Other full columns do nothing. Rare exception: openings made almost entirely of column-0 moves.
effect: None measurable: forcing the unit to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most about 3-6 points (column 0 is already full, so the move it concerns is illegal).
notes: Layer 0. Score 1: col0-full alone has recall 0.99 but precision 0.26 (F1 0.41). Act tests: peak right after the filling move (k=0), parity dip on odd k, decay that gets steeper with ply, and late fills (ply 36+) are weak. A hand-tuned estimate (fill ply, moves since fill, ply) gets F1 0.748, P 0.715, R 0.785, AUROC 0.89. Sim share is low (0.13-0.18). Doubts: the magnitude formula is approximate, and about 20% of firing is missed by the timing model.
